title: Kafka Cluster
description: Broker and KRaft health, throughput, request latency, saturation, replication, storage and JVM

panels.title: Under min ISR
panels.description: Producers with acks=all fail on these partitions

panels.title: Failed requests and request errors (/s)
panels.description: Some errors are normal (e.g. UNKNOWN_TOPIC_OR_PARTITION while a topic is created); look for sustained rates.

panels.title: Request total time (p99 / mean)
panels.description: FetchConsumer includes the consumer's fetch.max.wait.ms (500 ms by default), so a high value with no traffic is normal.

panels.title: Produce time breakdown (p99)
panels.description: Where produce time goes: queue = saturated handlers, local = disk, remote = followers (acks=all)

panels.title: Thread pool idle (%)
panels.description: Below 20% idle the broker is saturated

panels.title: ISR shrinks / expands (/s)
panels.description: Frequent shrinks mean followers fall behind (only possible with more than one broker)

panels.title: Metadata apply lag and Raft commit latency
Total log size and disk I/O
panels.description: Disk I/O is Linux only (reported by the broker from /proc)

panels.title: Container memory (cAdvisor)
panels.description: Needs cAdvisor on a Linux Docker host (on Docker Desktop containers have no name label)
